s: Mi hem happeturim mishibat sukka ubo k"b seipim: nashim vaabadim peturim min hassukka, mippene shehu mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama. Abal mi shechetzyo ebed vechetzyo ben chorin — chayyab besukka, mechamat tzad cherut shebbo:

Tumtum veanderoginos — chayyabim besukka missapeq shemma hu zakar, abal enam tzerikim lebarek "lesheb bassukka", shekkol sepeq berakot lehaqel, abal im yirtzu lebarek — hareshut beyadam kemo shennitbaer besiman y"z, ayyen sham. Vaapillu neqebot vaddaot im yirtzu lesheb bassukka ulebarek — hareshut beyadam. Abal mi shekkebar berak "lesheb bassukka" — lo yachazor vibarek kede lehotzi et hannashim, kevan sheen hannashim chayyabot bibraka zo — hare zo beraka lebattala kemo shennitbaer besiman tqp"t, ayyen sham:

Ap al pi shehaqqetannim peturim min hassukka min hattora ad sheyyihyu bene y"g shanim, mikkol maqom middibre soperim kol qatan sheeno tzarik leimmo, dehaynu ben shesh shanim shelemot, veim haqqatan chakam vecharip beinyan sheeno tzarik leimmo apillu keshehu ben chamesh shanim shelemot — chayyab besukka kede lechanneko bemitzvot. Abal kesheadayin hu tzarik leimmo, keshem sheimmo petura — kak hu patur apillu middibre soperim, kevan shehu tzarik lah:

Ap al pi shehaqqatan sheeno tzarik leimmo chayyab besukka, mikkol maqom im hu okel veyashen chutz lassukka — en tzerikin limchot beyado veligor bo kemo shennitbaer besiman shm"g. Abal abiv chayyab ligor bo velimchot beyado ulehakniso letok hassukka, kede lechanneko bemitzvot. Abal immo enah chayyebet lechanneko bemitzvot, vahare hi etzlo kishar kol adam. Umuttar lah litten lepanayv leekol chutz lassukka, ap al pi sheyyodaat shebbevadday lo yiknos lassukka leekol ella yokal bammaqom shennotna lepanayv — en bekak kelum, kevan sheenah omeret lo sheyyokal chutz lassukka:

Lo chiyyeba tora lesheb bassukka ella kederek sheadam dar bebeto kol hashshana, lepikak mi shehu mitztaer bishibat hassukka ukesheyyetze mimmenna yinnatzel min hatztzaar — patur min hassukka, sheap bekol hashshana en adam dar bemaqom shehu mitztaer. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishar seudot hechag, abal ballayla harishona ap hammitztaer chayyab leekol kezayit bassukka kemo shennitbaer besiman trl"t:

Ezehu mitztaer? Zeh sheeno yakol leekol o lishon bassukka mippene haruach shemmetzaaro, o mippene hazzebubim vehapparoshim vekayyotze bahen, o mippene reach ra shemmerichin betok hassukka, ukesheyyetze mimmenna yinnatzel mikkol ellu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Shennolad lo hatztzaar bemiqreh achar sheasa sham hassukka, abal im asa sukka bemaqom sheyyadua lo sheyyitztaer achar kak bah, kegon sheasa bemaqom sheharuach metzuya vesholetet sham, vaapillu asa bemaqom shello yihyeh lo tzaar baakila ella sheyyihyeh lo tzaar bashshena, kegon sheasa barechob shei epshar lo lishon sham benachat mechamat mora haggannabim vehallistim — hare sukka zo pesula, veeno yotze bah apillu baakila ap al pi sheen lo tzaar kelal bah, lepi shekkol sukka sheeno yakol leekol velishtot uletayyel velishon bah benachat belo shum tzaar — enah niqret dira kelal, lepi sheeno domeh lebeto sheyyakol laasot sham kol tzorko benachat. Abal mi sheasa sukka barechob veeno mityare benapsho lishon sham ballayla, ap al pi shemmityare shello yignebu kele tashmisho shebbassukka — hare zo keshera, shehare hi reuya lo ledira kevan sheeno mityare lishon bah, ukele tashmisho yakol lehaknisan ballayla letok habbayit. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla en laasot sukka barechob kemo shennitbaer besiman trl"z, ayyen sham:

Mi sheasa sukka qetanna beinyan shemmitztaer bah bashshena shello yukal lipshot bah yadayv veraglayv — hare zo keshera, vechayyab lishon bah velikpop yadayv veraglayv, lepi sheen chashub tzaar, shekken derek haadam shellipamim yashen bikpipat gupo veebarayv. Hammitztaer en patur min hassukka ella hu beatzmo, abal meshammeshayv chayyabim besukka, dehaynu sheim hem rotzim leekol o lishon — chayyabim liknos letok hassukka. Abal mi shehu choleh apillu en bo sakkana, apillu en lo ella mechosh berosho o beenayv vishibat hassukka qasha lo — gam meshammeshayv peturin min hassukka, lepi shehen oseqin bemitzva, vekol haoseq bemitzva — patur mimmitzva acheret, lepikak enan peturin ella beshaa shehem meshammeshim otan, sheaz hen oseqin bemitzva:

Mi shemmaqqiz dam — chayyab bassukka, sheeno mitztaer kelal, veadderabba hu sameach umarbeh baakila ushetiyya. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheeno maqqiz ella kede lishmor beriuto veeno margish shum choli beatzmo, abal im margish bo choli (mechamat haqqaza) veyesh sham qetzat qerirut — hare zeh patur min hassukka. Mikkol maqom, lekattechilla en lehaqqiz dam betok hechag im epshar lo lehaqqiz qodem hechag o lehitacher ad achar hechag, sheen laadam lehabi et atzmo lide tzaar bechag beinyan sheyyippater min hassukka. Umittaam zeh en lishtot sam hamshalshel betok hechag kol sheepshar lo lehaqdim o leacher. Veim abar veshata — patur min hassukka, kevan shehaqqerirut qasha lo:

Mi shekkabu lo nerotayv bassukka belel shabbat shebbetok hechag veyesh lo ner doleq betok beto — muttar lo latzet mehassukka veleekol betok beto bimqom hanner, lepi shetztzaar hu laadam leekol bachoshek belo ner. Vaapillu yesh lachabero ner besukkato — en omerim lazeh shekkabu nerotayv habe seudateka lesukkat chabereka veekol sham leor hanner, lepi shezzehu gam ken tzaar laadam leekol besukkat chabero, sheen areb laadam ella beshello. Mikkol maqom, im epshar lo labo lesukkat chabero belo torach gadol — en lehaqel baddabar, lepi sheen zeh mitztaer gamur sheyyippater min hassukka bishbil kak:

Muttar lipros beged o sadin bassukka min hatztzad beshabbat o beyom tob lehagen mippene haruach shello yekabbeh et hannerot, veen issur mishshum asiyyat ohel beshabbat ubeyom tob, sheen bammechitztza mishshum ohel kemo shennitbaer besiman sht"v. Abal asur lipros tachat hassekak, apillu im hu beinyan sheim lo yaaseh kak lo yukal leekol kelal bassukka mechamat haruach sheyyekabbeh et hannerot belel shabbat, lepi sheen mitzvat sukka docha et shum issur apillu shel dibrehem, mittaam shennitbaer besop siman tqp"v, ayyen sham. Abal muttar lipros al gabbe hassekak, im (ayyen siman trk"t magen abraham) hu sheim lo yaaseh kak lo yukal leekol bassukka, lepi sheen kan ohel kelal, kevan sheen gobah tepach ben hassadin lassekak shettachtayv. Abal im en barur lo sheim lo yipros sham sadin lo yukal leekol bassukka apillu bechol — asur lipros sadin tachat hassekak o al gabbe hassekak, mittaam shennitbaer besop siman trk"t:

En hammitztaer patur min hassukka ella im ken hu mitztaer bedabar shedderek bene adam lehitztaer bo, abal im hu mitztaer bedabar sheen darkan shel bene adam lehitztaer mechamat dabar zeh — betela dato etzel kol adam, ella im ken yadua shehu meanine haddaat vehu mitztaer bedabar shekkol anine haddaat mitztaarin mechamat dabar zeh, abal en kol adam yakol lomar meanine haddaat ani, ella im ken yadua shehu meanine haddaat:

Ap al pi shehayyashen bassukka bekilla sheyyesh lah gag rachab tepach vegaboah asara tepachim lo yatza yede chobato, mikkol maqom im yesh yattushin bassukka shemmetzaarin oto — mutab sheyyishan bekilla zeh mishsheyyishan chutz lassukka, lepi sheyyesh mi shemmattir lekattechilla lishon bekilla zo apillu bemaqom sheen sham yattushin, ap al pi sheen halaka kidbarayv bedabar zeh:

Abel chayyab besukka apillu beyom rishon, veap al pi shetztzaar hu lo lesheb bassukka, shehaabel chapetz lihyot mitboded lihyot tarud betzaaro ubeeblo — ap al pi ken chayyab lesheb bassukka, ulehasir haabelut millibbo beinyan shello yihyeh lo tzaar kelal bishiba bassukka. Abal im eno yakol lehasir haabelut millibbo, kegon shehammet chabib lo meod, veyesh lo tzaar bassukka sheeno yakol lihyot tarud sham baabelut kemo bebeto sheyyesheb sham badad — patur min hassukka:

Seudat berit mila, veken hasseuda sheokelin etzel hayyoledet (kak haya hamminhag bayyamim harishonim) — chayyabim bassukka, ap al pi shetztzar lahem hammaqom lashebet sham vei epshar lahem lismoach karauy — ap al pi ken yoklu bassukka, veotam anashim shetztzar lahem — lo yoklu kelal bisuda zo, ap al pi shesseudat berit mila hi seudat mitzva, mikkol maqom enah mitzva gedola kol kak lidchot mitzvat sukka bishbilah, shehi mitzvat aseh shel tora:

Hamhallek badderek bime hassukkot, im hu okel veyashen al pene hassadeh bemaqom sheen sham yishshub kelal — eno tzarik litroach velaasot lo sukka, apillu hu yosheb kol hechag bemaqom echad bassadeh veyesh lo sippuq laasot lo sukka bammaqom hazzeh — ap al pi ken eno tzarik litroach bishbil kak, ella im yesh sham bimqom chaniyyato sukka mukenet asuya leshem tzel — hare zeh yosheb bah, veim lav — okel veshoteh veyashen al pene hassadeh, lepi shehassukka hi keen dirat beto bekol hashshana, veen adam qobea dirato bemaqom sheen sham yishshub kelal:

Abal keshehiggia limqom yishshub, apillu hu yishshub goyim verotzeh leekol o lishon sham — chayyab laasot lo sukka, veyikkanes letokah leekol velishon. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyesh lo penay laasot sukka mishshaa shehiggia layyishshub ad sheat haakila vehashshena shel obere derakim kayyotze bo, dehaynu sheim hu mehallek bayyom velan ballayla beyishshub veyesh penay laasot sukka mishshehiggia layyishshub ad et haakila vehashshena shel obere derakim hammehallekim bayyom velanin bayyishshub umemaharin leekol velishon bitchillat hallayla beinyan sheyyukelu laqum behashkama lelek ledarkam. Abal im higgia layyishshub samuk leet haokel o leet hashshena shel obere derakim kayyotze bo, beinyan sheim yatriach laasot sukka qodem et haakila vehashshena shel obere derakim kayyotze bo yihyeh lo ikkub bedarko shello yukal lelek lemachar behashkama ledarko — eno tzarik litroach velaasot sukka, umuttar lo leekol velishon babbayit. Veen tzarik lomar sheim eno rotzeh lehitakkeb kelal bayyishshub raq leekol velishon ulemaher lelek ledarko, sheeno tzarik litroach velaasot sukka, kevan shemmechamat zeh yihyeh lo ikkub bedarko. Vaapillu im hu holek lidbar hareshut, mikkol maqom eno mechuyyab ladur bassukka biqbiut yeme hechag yoter mimmah shehu dar biqbiut bebeto kol hashshana, ukeshem shehu manniach et beto bekol hashshana veholek ladderek — kak muttar lo lehanniach sukkato velelek ladderek, ukeshem shebbekol hashshana keshehu badderek lipamim eno okel betok habbayit kede shello yihyeh lo ikkub bedarko — kak muttar lo leekol velishon chutz lassukka mippene ichur darko:

Otan haholekim lakkeparim litboa chobotehem velanim sham bakkepar, kevan shemmin haddin hem chayyabim laasot sham sukka, kevan shehem shohim umitakkebim harbeh bekol kepar ukepar, laken im enan osim sham sukka — asur lahem leekol velishon sham, utzerikin hem lashub lebattehem bekol layla leekol velishon bassukka:

Vekol zeh bemi sheholek lidbar hareshut, abal mi sheholek lidbar mitzva, kegon lehaqbil pene rabbo o lepidyon shebuyim vekayyotze bazeh, vehiggia layyishshub beod shello asa mitzvato — eno tzarik litroach velaasot sukka. Vaapillu im yesh sham sukka benuya, im enah mezummenet lepanayv — eno tzarik litroach velachazor achareha, umuttar lo leekol velishon babbayit, shekkol zeman sheeno bebeto vehu tarud bemachashebet hammitzva ubetiqquneha — hare zeh niqra oseq bemitzva, vekol haoseq bemitzva achat, en tzarik litroach ulechazzer achar mitzva acheret beod shehu oseq bemitzva zo. Veap al pi sheepshar lo leqayyem shette hammitzvot beli shum shihuy veikkub lehammitzva sheoseq bah, mikkol maqom hattora petarattu millitroach ulechazzer achar mitzva acheret kemo shennitbaer besiman l"ch. Abal im eno tzarik litroach ulechazzer achar sukka, kegon sheyyesh sukka mezummenet lepanayv — chayyab liknos letokah leekol velishon. Veim eno yakol leekol velishon kol kak betob bassukka kemo babbayit veyihyeh yagea lemachar mechamat meniat hashshena velo yukal laasoq bammitzva karauy — patur millishon bassukka:

Shomere hair bayyom, dehaynu kol hayyom hen mehallekin sebib hair leshomrah miggeyasot habbaot aleha — peturin min hassukka kol hayyom, umuttar lahem leekol chutz lassukka, vaapillu im yesh sham sukka mukenet — enam tzerikim liknos letokah leekol im hu beinyan sheal yede ken yitbattelu mishshemiratan, abal chayyabim bassukka ballayla, sheaz enan shomerim et hair. Veim hem shomerim ballayla velo bayyom — peturim ballayla vechayyabim bayyom:

Shomere ginnot upardesim shehen qebuin sham bayyom uballayla — peturin min hassukka ben bayyom ben ballayla. Veap al pi shehen qebuin bemaqom echad kol yeme hechag — ap al pi ken en mechayyebin oto laasot sukka bammaqom hahu, lepi sheim yaaseh hashshomer sukka bemaqom echad yeda haggannab sheyyesh lo lashshomer maqom qabua veyabo veyignob mimmaqom acher, venimtza sheal yede hassukka en shemirato kelum, vehattora lo chiyyeba laasot sukka ella kemo sheddar bebeto, vezeh shemmanniach dirat beto bishbil shemirat mamono mehepsed — en mechayyebin oto lesheb bassukka, sheal yede zeh yaggia lo hepsed lemamono. Abal im haya shomer keri shel tebua, sheyyakol lishmor kol hakkeri mimmeqom qebiato — chayyab laasot lo sukka bimqom qebiato, kevan shello yaggia lo shum hepsed al yede kak, ap al pi shessukka zo tihyeh rechoqa min hair beinyan shei epshar lo lehabi lesham kol kele tashmisho shehu mishtammesh bahen bebeto, mikkol maqom kevan shemmenia zo enah mechamat hassukka, shehare ap im lo yaaseh bekan sukka lo yishtammesh bikle tashmisho shebbebeto, lekak eno niptar min hassukka bishbil kak:

Veken otan hayyoshebin bachanut kol hayyom, apillu im darim chutz lair rachoq min chanuyyotehem shebbetok hair — ap al pi ken chayyabim laasot sukka etzel chanuyyotehem leekol sham, veasur lahem leekol betok hachanut. Veim i epshar lahem laasot sukka etzel hachanut — tzerikim lashub lebattehem leekol bassukka:

Yisreelim hassekurim etzel nokri bechag hassukkot laasot betok karmo et yeno — peturin min hassukka ben bayyom uben ballayla, lepi shehen tzerikim lishmor tamid et hayyayin mimmagga nokri. Abal im hu beinyan sheen tzarik lishmor tamid, kegon shehayyayin kebar naasa beheksher umunnach bachatzero shel hannokri, sheen hayyisrael tzarik lihyot yosheb umeshammer tamid, ella keshehayyisrael dar bechatzer zo shehayyayin betoko day bekak kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea besiman ql"a, ulekak chayyab hu laasot sukka bechatzer zo veladur betokah kol yeme hechag:
